name: Esslingen am Neckar (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided green over red, charged at the centre with the city arms of Esslingen am Neckar (a black imperial eagle on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Esslingen am Neckar; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Esslingen arms — black eagle on yellow
